title: Troubleshoot a new technology from English docs
summary: Đọc documentation, tạo hypothesis và thử nghiệm an toàn mà không cần bản dịch.

sections.title: Worker retry documentation
sections.content: Retries are scheduled only when the handler returns an error. Uncaught exceptions are recorded as failed attempts. A job moves to the dead-letter queue after maxAttempts. Setting maxAttempts to 1 disables retries.

exercises.question: Vì sao job có thể không retry?
exercises.explanation: Docs nói rõ giá trị 1 sẽ tắt retry.

performanceTask.title: Plan a safe troubleshooting experiment
performanceTask.scenario: Một worker mới không retry như nhóm kỳ vọng; bạn chỉ có đoạn documentation và config.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Read the documentation once, hide it, then write a diagnostic plan without the model.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Tóm tắt rule từ docs, nêu hypothesis, cách kiểm tra an toàn, expected signal và rollback.
performanceTask.modelResponse: The docs say retries require maxAttempts above one and an error result from the handler. My first hypothesis is that maxAttempts is set to one in this environment. I would inspect the effective config, then enqueue one synthetic failing job in staging with maxAttempts set to three. The expected signal is three recorded attempts before dead-lettering. I would revert the test config and remove the synthetic job afterwards.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Sửa kế hoạch để tách doc fact, hypothesis, expected signal và cleanup.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Docs của một cache nói TTL=0 means no expiry. Viết kế hoạch kiểm tra an toàn cho bug stale data.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Từ unseen docs đã đọc một lần, tạo hypothesis và safe experiment có expected signal.

artifacts.title: Retry documentation
artifacts.content: Retries are scheduled only when the handler returns an error. A job moves to dead-letter after maxAttempts. Setting maxAttempts to 1 disables retries. Effective configuration may differ by environment.

retry.title: Worker effective configuration
retry.brief: Use focused facts to repair hypothesis, expected signal or cleanup.

transfer.title: Cache expiry behavior
transfer.brief: Unseen documentation: design a safe stale-data experiment.

artifacts.title: Cache TTL documentation
artifacts.content: TTL is measured in seconds. TTL=0 means entries do not expire automatically. cache.invalidate(key) removes one entry. The effective TTL can be inspected with cachectl describe --key KEY.

review.title: Circuit breaker recovery
review.brief: Delayed retrieval with a different technology rule.

artifacts.title: Circuit breaker documentation
artifacts.content: The breaker opens after five failures in thirty seconds. It remains open for coolDownSeconds, then permits one probe request. A successful probe closes the breaker; a failed probe reopens it.

trainingSource.title: Batch concurrency documentation
trainingSource.content: concurrency controls simultaneous jobs. A value of zero pauses dispatch without deleting queued jobs. Changes apply to new dispatches only. Use scheduler status to confirm active and queued counts.

extractionItems.question: What does concurrency zero do?
extractionItems.feedback: The docs separate dispatch from queue retention.

extractionItems.question: When does a changed value apply?
extractionItems.feedback: The scope limits the expected signal.

extractionItems.question: What verifies the behavior?
extractionItems.feedback: The status command supplies observable evidence.
